acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CVPAT uses the PLSpredict settings, with 10 folds and 10 repetitions documented as the defaults.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe records fold count and repetition count, and a new run starts with 10 for each setting.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS states that its CVPAT-producing PLSpredict workflow defaults to 10 folds and 10 repetitions.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh setup, saved recipe, Run Details, and reopened setup all preserve the documented 10-by-10 default unless the user changes it.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CVPAT evaluates and substantiates the out-of-sample predictive capabilities of a PLS-SEM model against benchmark predictions.
acceptance_criteria: Only an eligible PLS-SEM prediction model can run this parity cell; all additional shape restrictions remain explicit until a dated desktop fixture closes them.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page explains splitting a full dataset but does not enumerate accepted file or matrix inputs, minimum case counts, missing-value policies, or fold-feasibility rules.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop fixture captures accepted data forms, missing-data behavior, minimum usable cases, and invalid-fold diagnostics before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS uses earliest-antecedent indicators for both CVPAT and PLSpredict, computes out-of-sample prediction errors, and compares average loss with IA and LM benchmarks.
acceptance_criteria: The compiled plan records earliest-antecedent selection and produces identical fold assignments, loss aggregation, and benchmark inputs after save/reopen for a fixed seed.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CVPAT reports whether the PLS-SEM average loss is significantly lower than the IA and LM benchmark losses; a favorable loss difference is negative.
acceptance_criteria: Results separately expose PLS, IA, and LM average losses, signed differences, inference values, comparison direction, and observation/fold accounting without reversing the sign convention.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not specify a required CVPAT chart, its controls, or its export behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop chart inventory records every CVPAT chart or records evidenced absence; optional QuickPLS charts cannot substitute for undocumented parity claims.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not document exact rejection behavior for infeasible folds, failed fold models, constant outcomes, missing benchmark predictions, or non-finite losses.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger captures current behavior, while QuickPLS must always return a typed preflight or run failure and retain every attempted fold in its accounting.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS exposes CVPAT results in the PLSpredict results report as a formal complement to descriptive PLSpredict statistics.
acceptance_criteria: A user can configure one prediction run, inspect its linked CVPAT IA and LM comparisons, save/reopen it, and export the same canonical values.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page calls CCA a series of steps but does not enumerate a SmartPLS setup dialog, selectable options, or dependencies among those steps.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop fixture captures every executable CCA step and setting; no single residual calculation may be presented as full CCA parity without that inventory.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not state CCA defaults, thresholds, resampling counts, inference choices, or result-selection defaults.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop defaults matrix records each default and its controlling step before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CCA is used with composite-based SEM to confirm reflective and formative measurement models within a specified nomological network, and SmartPLS states full support in PLS-SEM.
acceptance_criteria: Qualification covers both reflective and formative measurement models in their nomological network; a reflective-only or residual-only subset remains partial.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify accepted input forms, scale requirements, missing-value handling, or minimum observations for each CCA step.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop fixture captures accepted data, scale, missingness, and sample constraints for every CCA step.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not define the exact preprocessing, order of steps, estimands, residual construction, or inference transformations used by the desktop workflow.
acceptance_criteria: A dated algorithm-and-desktop fixture freezes step order and mathematical targets; undocumented choices stay open rather than being inferred from one CCA school of thought.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: although SmartPLS states that it fully supports CCA, this page does not enumerate the complete tables, statistics, decisions, warnings, or provenance emitted by the workflow.
acceptance_criteria: A dated results fixture inventories every CCA table and statistic before the capability can move from a bounded residual implementation to full coverage.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not identify required CCA charts, their display controls, source tables, or export behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop chart inventory records each chart or evidenced absence before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not document how SmartPLS handles ineligible models, unidentified step requirements, failed inference, or inconclusive CCA evidence.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger closes current behavior, and QuickPLS must return typed failures without substituting a successful residual-only result.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CCA is a confirmatory measurement-model workflow for composite estimation, but the official page notes an ongoing methodological dispute and does not generally recommend it as the primary measurement-model evaluation approach.
acceptance_criteria: Method Details preserves the confirmatory purpose and methodological caution, and the run remains linked to its complete sequence of CCA steps.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CTA-PLS exposes bootstrap subsamples, parallel processing, one- versus two-sided test type, and significance level.
acceptance_criteria: All four controls are persisted in the recipe and reflected in inference, with process count constrained to available processors.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page gives 500 and 10,000 as initial and final examples, but does not identify the current default subsamples, test type, significance level, process count, or seed behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop defaults matrix records each control; example recommendations are not silently relabeled as defaults.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the implemented CTA-PLS procedure requires at least 4 and at most 25 manifest variables per tested construct and tests a reflective null specification.
acceptance_criteria: Preflight accepts only tested constructs with 4 through 25 indicators and identifies the exact construct when the bound is violated.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CTA-PLS bootstrap subsamples draw observations from the original dataset with replacement and estimate them with the PLS-SEM algorithm.
acceptance_criteria: Each resample contains the documented case count with replacement, and the ledger binds its indices to the source dataset and PLS recipe.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CTA-PLS forms model-implied vanishing tetrads and applies bootstrapping to test their significance against the reflective-measurement null hypothesis.
acceptance_criteria: A transparent fixture verifies tetrad generation, redundancy handling, null orientation, and bootstrap statistics for 4-, 5-, and larger-indicator constructs.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CTA-PLS reports bootstrap significance of model-implied tetrads to help judge whether a construct is more consistent with formative or reflective measurement.
acceptance_criteria: Results expose every nonredundant tetrad, original estimate, bootstrap inference, test side, alpha, and construct-level interpretation without presenting descriptive tetrads as inferential parity.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not identify any required CTA-PLS chart, chart controls, or chart export behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop chart inventory records each chart or evidenced absence before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: fewer than 4 or more than 25 manifest variables are outside the implemented procedure, and requested processes must not exceed available processors.
acceptance_criteria: Each documented invalid setup fails in preflight with the construct or process control and a corrective action; no partial inferential result is committed.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page explains configuration and interpretation but does not freeze the exact Calculate entry, results navigation, rerun, cancellation, persistence, or export sequence.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop workflow fixture captures start-to-export behavior, while QuickPLS independently verifies cancellation and archive round-trip.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: HTMT inference requires Bootstrapping with Amount of results set to Complete (slower) and Test type set to one-tailed.
acceptance_criteria: HTMT inference is selectable only when complete bootstrap result families and one-tailed testing are configured, and the recipe records both choices.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the official guidance uses 0.90 as the HTMT critical value and recommends HTMT below 0.90 for discriminant validity.
acceptance_criteria: The results interpretation uses and records 0.90 when reproducing the documented workflow; any configurable alternative is labeled as a user choice rather than the SmartPLS documented criterion.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: HTMT assesses whether reflectively measured constructs are empirically distinct from other constructs in a PLS path model.
acceptance_criteria: The compiler enumerates eligible reflective construct pairs and does not silently produce HTMT for formative-only pairs.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS computes HTMT+ from absolute correlations between indicators belonging to the compared reflective constructs.
acceptance_criteria: The analytical sample and missing-data policy used to form each indicator correlation are linked to the PLS or PLSc run and reproduced after archive reopen.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: since SmartPLS 3.2.1 the computation uses absolute rather than signed indicator correlations, yielding the HTMT+ form normed between 0 and 1.
acceptance_criteria: A mixed-sign hand fixture distinguishes HTMT+ from the original signed formula and keeps every finite result within the documented 0-to-1 range.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PLS and PLSc reports include HTMT under Quality Criteria, while complete bootstrapping adds HTMT inference whose bias-corrected upper confidence bound is compared with 0.90.
acceptance_criteria: Results include the pairwise HTMT+ matrix and, for eligible complete-bootstrap runs, the bias-corrected upper bound and one-tailed decision for every pair.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page documents tables and report sections but not any required HTMT chart, chart controls, or chart export behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop chart inventory records each chart or evidenced absence before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not specify messages for insufficient reflective constructs or indicators, undefined correlations, zero variance, failed resamples, or unavailable bias-corrected bounds.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger captures current desktop behavior, and QuickPLS emits a typed pair-level or run-level failure with complete resample accounting.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: users inspect descriptive HTMT after PLS or PLSc estimation and run Calculate -> Bootstrapping with Complete (slower) and one-tailed testing for HTMT inference.
acceptance_criteria: Descriptive and inferential HTMT remain linked to their exact source runs and can be saved, reopened, compared, and exported without changing pair order or decisions.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: approximate SRMR and NFI are available from PLS or PLSc results, while d_ULS, d_G, and SRMR inference require the complete bootstrap option and an adapted Bollen-Stine procedure.
acceptance_criteria: Setup distinguishes point fit from exact-fit inference and cannot present ordinary bootstrap intervals as the adapted Bollen-Stine result.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page discusses estimated versus saturated models and 95% or 99% upper bounds but does not state the current selected model, confidence level, resample count, or displayed fit thresholds as desktop defaults.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop defaults matrix captures these values, and interpretive recommendations are not silently converted into UI defaults.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS discusses composite fit for all-formative models, common-factor fit for all-reflective models, and mixed fit when reflective and formative measurement models are combined.
acceptance_criteria: Qualification contains all-formative, all-reflective, and mixed fixtures and records the scientific estimand used for every implied matrix.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the reported discrepancies compare the empirical correlation matrix with a model-implied correlation matrix; Chi-square also uses the observation count.
acceptance_criteria: The result records the analytical sample size and fingerprints both empirical and implied matrices from the same PLS or PLSc run.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: complete bootstrap first obtains regular parameter inference, then applies adapted Bollen-Stine processing with separate saturated-model and estimated-model computations for d_ULS, d_G, and SRMR intervals.
acceptance_criteria: The resampling ledger distinguishes both rounds and the saturated and estimated computations; every failed computation remains counted.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS reports SRMR, d_ULS, d_G, NFI, Chi-square, and degrees of freedom, with saturated and estimated model distinctions and Bollen-Stine inference for the exact-fit discrepancies.
acceptance_criteria: All named measures are reported where applicable; exact-fit interpretation compares the original discrepancy with its interval upper bound and never treats a raw d_ULS or d_G value alone as decisive.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not freeze required fit charts, their display defaults, source tables, or export behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop chart inventory records each chart or evidenced absence before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not state exact behavior for singular or non-positive-definite matrices, undefined geodesic distance, unavailable degrees of freedom, failed Bollen-Stine runs, or non-finite criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger captures desktop behavior, and QuickPLS emits typed criterion-level or run-level failures without placeholder zeros or heuristic substitutes.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: users inspect approximate fit after PLS or PLSc estimation and run complete bootstrapping when they require Bollen-Stine exact-fit inference for saturated and estimated models.
acceptance_criteria: The result navigation clearly separates the two workflows and preserves every model variant, criterion, interval, warning, and source run through save/reopen and export.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the Model comparison start dialog lets the user select a second model to compare with the currently open PLS-SEM model.
acceptance_criteria: The setup binds two distinct saved model identities and blocks a stale, missing, or identical selection before execution.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not enumerate defaults for folds, repetitions, seed, prediction metrics, BIC variants, Akaike-weight calculation, result amount, or comparison orientation.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop defaults matrix freezes each control before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the feature compares two distinct, theoretically plausible alternative PLS-SEM models created within a project.
acceptance_criteria: Qualification includes structurally different alternatives and never fabricates comparability for a non-PLS method family.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify whether the two models must use the same dataset version, analytical cases, outcomes, indicators, missing-data policy, weights, or fold assignments.
acceptance_criteria: A dated compatibility fixture freezes current desktop rules; QuickPLS fails closed unless data, outcomes, preprocessing, and resampling are scientifically comparable.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: model comparison evaluates the alternatives using PLSpredict, CVPAT, BIC for predictive selection, and Akaike weights.
acceptance_criteria: One comparison receipt identifies the exact two model versions and the complete prediction, test, BIC, and Akaike-weight settings used for both alternatives.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the generated comparison results include PLSpredict, CVPAT, BIC, and Akaike weights so users can judge which alternative is advantageous.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical document presents both models in a stable orientation and includes every named criterion, its preferred direction, and any incompatibility warning.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not identify required comparison charts, chart defaults, source tables, or export behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop chart inventory records each chart or evidenced absence before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not state exact diagnostics for incompatible data, outcomes, estimands, methods, settings, folds, nonconverged component runs, or unavailable criteria.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger closes current behavior; QuickPLS reports the precise incompatibility and never commits a partial comparison as complete.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: users create two alternatives in one project, open the first model, choose Calculate -> Model comparison, select the second model, run, and inspect the combined results.
acceptance_criteria: The two source models and comparison remain linked after rename, save/reopen, report comparison, and export.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: prediction-oriented selection compares a pre-determined range of alternative PLS-SEM setups using BIC results supplied by SmartPLS.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe records an explicit candidate set and the exact BIC definition; it never searches unrecorded alternatives.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS provides BIC for model selection and does not implement the Geweke-Meese criterion because defining the saturated PLS model is not always straightforward.
acceptance_criteria: The active parity result exposes BIC and does not advertise GM as a SmartPLS parity requirement.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: the candidate set consists of alternative PLS-SEM model setups, including situations where advanced structures make a saturated comparator hard to define.
acceptance_criteria: Qualification covers multiple explicit candidate topologies and retains moderation or higher-order candidates only when the BIC contract supports them.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not state exact same-data, outcome, indicator, missing-value, weighting, or sample-size compatibility requirements across candidates.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop compatibility fixture closes these rules; QuickPLS fails closed when candidates do not share a scientifically comparable analytical basis.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS uses the in-sample BIC as a substitute for out-of-sample selection criteria and selects the alternative that minimizes BIC.
acceptance_criteria: Candidate ordering cannot alter calculated BIC values or the winner; ties follow a recorded deterministic rule.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: users compare BIC across alternative setups and select the model with the lowest BIC value.
acceptance_criteria: Results list every declared candidate, its BIC, rank, differences, selection status, and any tie without omitting unsuccessful candidates from the ledger.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not identify required BIC-selection charts, display defaults, source tables, or exports.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop chart inventory records each chart or evidenced absence before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not state exact behavior for incompatible candidates, unavailable BIC, failed estimation, identical BIC, an empty candidate set, or a single candidate.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger closes current behavior, while QuickPLS returns typed incompatibility or no-selection states and never silently drops candidates.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: researchers define a range of alternative model setups, compare their BIC values, and choose the lowest-BIC model; CVPAT predictive assessment is a separate implemented workflow.
acceptance_criteria: The saved selection run preserves the candidate set, BIC path, winner, and distinction from CVPAT through reopen and export.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PLSpredict exposes Number of Folds and Number of Repetitions, with 10 documented as the default for each.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe persists both controls and changing either changes the recorded cross-validation design.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: a fresh PLSpredict setup defaults to 10 folds and 10 repetitions.
acceptance_criteria: Setup, Run Details, archive reopen, and exports preserve the 10-by-10 default unless explicitly changed.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: PLSpredict generates out-of-sample predictions for manifest variables and latent variables of a PLS path model.
acceptance_criteria: Qualification includes eligible indicator and construct outcomes; any restrictions for formative targets, higher-order models, interactions, or multiple outcomes remain explicit until evidenced.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: k-fold cross-validation splits the full dataset into holdout folds and uses the remaining folds as training samples.
acceptance_criteria: Every usable case is assigned to the documented training/holdout design, and case, missing-value, and fold counts are retained in the result ledger.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: repeated random k-fold splits generate PLS predictions and compare them with a training-mean IA benchmark and an LM benchmark built by regressing exogenous indicators on each endogenous indicator.
acceptance_criteria: Fixed-seed runs reproduce fold assignments, training-only preprocessing, PLS predictions, IA predictions, and LM predictions without holdout leakage.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: manifest-variable results include RMSE, MAE, and MAPE; latent-variable results include RMSE and MAE; Q2predict compares PLS with IA; LM comparisons are available only for manifest variables; CVPAT is included in the report.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical result reports each metric only at its documented level, includes PLS/IA/LM comparisons and Q2predict, and links CVPAT without fabricating latent-variable MAPE or LM values.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the official page does not freeze required prediction charts, display controls, case-level views, or export behavior.
acceptance_criteria: A dated current-desktop chart inventory records every chart or evidenced absence before full parity is claimed.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify exact behavior for infeasible folds, constant or zero-valued outcomes, undefined MAPE, failed PLS or LM fits, missing predictions, or non-finite metrics.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger captures current behavior; QuickPLS returns typed metric/fold failures and keeps all attempted folds and repetitions in the ledger.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: users run repeated k-fold prediction to assess out-of-sample power, inspect indicator and construct errors against IA and LM benchmarks, and access CVPAT in the same results report.
acceptance_criteria: The run can be saved, reopened, compared with a compatible model, and exported with identical folds, metrics, benchmarks, and CVPAT linkage.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: IPMA setup selects a target construct, chooses all direct-and-indirect predecessors or direct predecessors only, and lets users inspect and correct each manifest variable's possible range.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe persists target, predecessor scope, and every theoretical indicator range, and invalid target/range combinations fail before execution.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS preconfigures ranges from the actual dataset minimum and maximum, while warning that these may differ from the theoretical possible range and should be corrected.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh setup displays observed min/max as an editable prefill, labels them as observed rather than theoretical, and records whether the user confirmed or changed each range.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: IPMA maps either direct predecessors or all direct and indirect predecessor constructs of one selected target construct in a PLS path model.
acceptance_criteria: Graph traversal produces the exact direct or transitive predecessor set, handles multiple paths deterministically, and excludes non-predecessors.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: correct 0-to-100 performance rescaling requires the original possible minimum and maximum for every manifest variable, such as 1 and 7 for a seven-point scale.
acceptance_criteria: Data binding preserves theoretical scale metadata separately from observed minima/maxima and identifies every indicator whose values fall outside the confirmed range.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: IPMA rescales data to produce performance scores on a 0-to-100 scale using the confirmed possible indicator ranges.
acceptance_criteria: Hand fixtures verify endpoint and midpoint rescaling, reversed scales only after an explicit transformation, and identical results after archive reopen.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: IPMA reports constructs along the two dimensions of importance for explaining the selected target and current performance, with manifest-variable results included for either predecessor scope.
acceptance_criteria: Results include construct and manifest-variable importance/performance values, target, predecessor scope, confirmed ranges, and stable labels suitable for map reconstruction.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS offers importance-performance map representations for the selected target and both predecessor scopes explicitly include manifest-variable charts.
acceptance_criteria: Construct and MV charts derive from the canonical tables, label both axes and target, remain accessible without color alone, and export the same plotted values.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: incorrect possible ranges produce incorrect performance values, so observed min/max must not be accepted silently when the theoretical scale differs.
acceptance_criteria: Range validation prevents an unverified observed minimum or maximum from being silently treated as the theoretical scale boundary.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify exact messages or result behavior for an invalid target, no eligible predecessors, reversed or zero-width ranges, data outside a range, missing scores, or non-finite importance values.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger captures current behavior; QuickPLS returns a typed object-specific failure and never publishes a partial map as complete.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: users select the IPMA target and predecessor scope, verify or correct indicator ranges, then interpret high-importance and low-performance areas as action priorities.
acceptance_criteria: Setup, results, maps, saved report, and exports preserve the same target, scope, ranges, importance, and performance values.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: NCA exposes Number of steps for bottleneck tables; NCA permutation exposes permutation count, parallel processing, significance level, and random-versus-fixed seed selection.
acceptance_criteria: The recipe records all algorithm and permutation controls and produces deterministic permutation results when a fixed seed is chosen.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: bottleneck tables default to 10 steps from 0% to 100%, and the page identifies CE-FDH and CR-FDH as the two default ceiling lines.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh run uses 10 bottleneck steps and produces both CE-FDH and CR-FDH outputs unless explicitly changed by a documented control.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: SmartPLS supports NCA for regression models and permits PLS-SEM partial regressions using unstandardized latent scores or 0-to-100 IPMA scores.
acceptance_criteria: Qualification covers multiple conditions for a regression outcome and score-derived PLS partial-regression inputs with explicit source-run linkage.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: NCA uses condition and outcome values or PLS-derived latent scores, and users must verify that indicator or score scales have the expected possible range.
acceptance_criteria: The dataset binds one outcome and one or more conditions, preserves their observed and theoretical ranges, and links derived scores immutably to the source PLS/IPMA run.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: CE-FDH is a non-decreasing step ceiling, CR-FDH regresses through that ceiling, and permutation testing estimates the nonparametric reference distribution for effect-size significance.
acceptance_criteria: Hand and oracle fixtures verify ceiling construction, CR-FDH regression, scope and ceiling-zone calculation, and index-exact permutations.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: NCA reports ceiling accuracy, necessity effect size d between 0 and 1, permutation significance, and bottleneck tables in actual values, range percentages, or percentiles.
acceptance_criteria: Results include CE-FDH and CR-FDH accuracy, d, significance, complete bottleneck tables for every condition, range basis, and the documented effect-size bands.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: NCA visualizes observations in scatter plots with CE-FDH and CR-FDH ceiling lines separating observed and empty regions.
acceptance_criteria: Each condition-outcome chart plots canonical observations and both ceiling lines, uses non-color cues, and exports the same line coordinates and axis ranges.

acceptance_items.description: Open live-app detail: the page does not specify exact handling of constant conditions or outcomes, zero scope, tied extreme points, invalid ranges, empty rows, unavailable CR-FDH regression, or failed permutations.
acceptance_criteria: A dated failure ledger captures current behavior; QuickPLS returns typed condition-level or run-level failures and never emits NaN, an invented line, or a partial success without disclosure.

acceptance_items.description: Documented fact: users run NCA for regression data, inspect ceiling and bottleneck results, optionally run NCA permutation for effect-size significance, and may feed unstandardized or IPMA 0-to-100 PLS scores into partial-regression NCA.
acceptance_criteria: Algorithm, permutation, charts, bottlenecks, and any score-source run remain linked through save/reopen and semantic export.
